author: reek
body: AC small-signal frequency response analysis. Computes magnitude and phase across a frequency range and provides stability metrics such as gain margin and phase margin.

author: reek
body: Linear interpolation on an AC trace to find magnitude at a given frequency. Scans adjacent point pairs and interpolates between the bracketing pair.

author: reek
body: Finds the -3dB bandwidth frequency. First locates the peak magnitude, then scans for the frequency where magnitude drops 3dB below peak.
